what_works: Dark-forward Swiss grid with placeholder SVGs revealing the underlying structure of the page — the skeleton IS the design. Project tiles drop in as content, but the grid remains visible as an honest architectural decision.
what_does_not_translate: Dark placeholder-driven aesthetic reads agency-cool; for trades, lift the visible-grid honesty and disciplined whitespace, swap dark canvas for light.
type_observations: Single grotesk family, no decoration, hierarchy purely from size + position. The grid itself does the typographic work.
